evidence.title: Equinix Launches AI-Ready Data Center with Direct Connectivity to Hong Kong–Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park
evidence.excerpt: Equinix's dated release says it officially opened HK6 and explicitly states that the opened facility provides 1,000 cabinets in its first phase.
